275401017.description: This lot includes eight sealed 8mm video cassette tapes from Sony, Maxell, and TDK. Each tape has a 120-minute recording time and is compatible with 8mm camcorders. The selection features models like Sony P6-120MP, TDK MP Superior Grade 8mm 120, and Maxell GX-MP 8mm 120. These tapes come in original retail packaging and include both standard and metal particle formulations.

274953223.description: This lot contains a large assortment of uncut rough mineral and gemstone specimens in various types, colors, and sizes. Included are rose quartz (pink), amethyst (purple), sodalite or lapis lazuli (blue), green aventurine, jasper, and other unidentified minerals. The collection also features smaller tumbled and raw stones and chips. Pieces range from large and chunky to small and granular. All stones are in raw, unpolished condition with natural textures and fractures visible. This mixed lot is suitable for collectors, educators, or rockhounding enthusiasts. No brand or manufacturer information is available.

Description:
Discover a unique assortment with this mixed gemstone lot, perfect for collectors, jewelry makers, or enthusiasts exploring natural minerals. This selection includes five distinct pieces: a finely polished agate slice showcasing intricate banding and rich, earthy hues; a rectangular amber piece featuring an organic inclusion; a clear quartz crystal point with natural terminations; a rough reddish-brown tourmaline cluster exhibiting raw crystal structure; and a deep garnet cluster with naturally formed surfaces. Each stone brings its own visual appeal and tactile qualities, whether you're interested in display, crafting, or study. The agate slice is ideal for decorative settings, the amber is prized by fossil and crystal lovers, while tourmaline, quartz, and garnet are versatile for lapidary or educational use. Condition ranges from polished to raw, highlighting the beauty of each gem's origin. Purchase confidently knowing each stone is naturally sourced and untreated, making this lot a diverse addition for any gemstone aficionado.
